feedback.connectionGuide:
Server: {{origin}}.
Connect this Agent session to the current Anjian artifact {{artifact}}, scoped only to this artifact.
Read this project’s AGENTS.md first. Reuse its configured CLI wrapper, project path and private configuration directory; do not assume anjian is globally installed.
Use that entry’s --help and skills get artifacts to discover the current instructions. Read the artifacts Skill and its remote connection guide, then authorize and connect using the supported workflow. Do not print tokens or access keys in chat.
Report the friendly connection name shown in the viewer. Do not automatically submit historical comments.
